headline: The incident transfer protocol is clear and the gold follows it, but the grader cannot tell whether the agent waited for the third request or skipped identity verification as instructed.

issues.summary: ACTION grading is presence-only, so it cannot enforce the documented sequence (1822 on request 1, 0218 on request 2, transfer on request 3) or the instruction not to verify identity or troubleshoot.
evidence: doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_011: "Always maintain this order... Do not skip steps." and "Do not ask for verification information or attempt to verify the user's identity."
evaluator_action._check_actions ignores order and extra calls; gold[4].compare_args = []
issues.why_it_matters: An agent that fires 1822, 0218 and the transfer all at the first request, or that verifies identity first, still scores 1. Correct work is never failed.
issues.suggested_fix: Grade order relative to the user's requests, or add an NL/ENV assertion that no verification happened before the transfer.

solution_check: Symptoms (statement paid, deducted from checking, not reflected) match doc_011, and get_current_time (11/14 03:40) is inside the window that ends 11/15/2025. The user makes 3 transfer requests, giving unlock+call 1822, unlock+call 0218, then transfer_to_human_agents. That is identical to the gold.
prior_note: Prior rated this task clean. The task is well-posed; the new Minor finding is ACTION-grading leniency.
notes: Grading-model facts confirmed against the v1.0.1 snapshot: upstream EnvironmentEvaluator compares exact agent/user DB hashes after replaying gold; call_discoverable_agent_tool logs reads only when in the gold-derived allowlist (_derive_read_log_allowlist) and always logs mutating tools; both call_discoverable_agent_tool and call_discoverable_user_tool parse JSON with parse_int=float; ACTION grading is presence-only on compare_args; KnowledgeUserTools shares the same TransactionalDB; get_now() = 2025-11-14 03:40. Additional facts: unlock_discoverable_agent_tool writes nothing to the DB (in-memory state only); give_discoverable_user_tool writes user_discoverable_tools keyed by tool name only (arguments not stored); user-tool results are routed back to the user only (Orchestrator ENV->USER), so the agent never sees them; no agent tool reads the cash_back_disputes table. Verified scorer (working repo _verified_db_match) confirmed: agent_discoverable_tools is a subset check, closure_reason stripped, every other table (incl. user_discoverable_tools, user_discoverable_tool_calls) exact. ACTION-only task; the verified scorer has no effect.
